{{Quote|Kashyyyk is mostly wroshyr forest&mdash;good defensive cover, bad to land in&mdash;but at Kachiro, the shallow open water of the Wartaki Sea offered a good approach for a troop landing, and the lines of communication into the interior were excellent.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gett]]|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
The '''Wartaki Sea''' was an open body of shallow [[Water/Legends|water]] located on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]]. The [[Wawaatt Archipelago/Legends|Wawaatt Archipelago]] was located in the Wartaki Sea. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] conquered [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], a [[City/Legends|city]] of the Wawaatt Archipelago. In order to [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|retake]] the city, the enemy [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] brought its landing force to Kachirho by sea.<ref name="Warfare" />
